subject: [PATCH v8 23/30] mm/mincore: report PMD swap-cache residency

2026-10-02.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the mincore function where it incorrectly reports huge PMD pages as resident when they are actually swapped out. The patch introduces a new function, mincore_pmd_swap, which looks up the swap cache for PMD-sized folios and returns residency information for each page within that range. If the PMD-sized folio was split while its entry remained in the swap cache, the function falls back to looking up each covered slot individually. The patch also adds a new check to handle PMD swap entries without CONFIG_THP_SWAP enabled.
